sources.quote: Today we are announcing a 64% price reduction on input tokens, a 52% price reduction on output tokens, and a 64% price reduction on incremental cached tokens for our strongest 1.5 series model, Gemini 1.5 Pro, [effective October 1st, 2024](https://ai.google.dev/pricing), on prompts less than 128K tokens.
sources.supports: Google confirms Gemini 1.5 Pro had paid incremental cached-token pricing and that pricing changed effective October 1, 2024, but this passage does not give the resulting per-token amounts needed to establish the official cache_read price for June 2025.

notes: Google's announcement establishes that cached-token pricing existed and had been reduced effective October 1, 2024, so models.dev's omitted cache_read may have been an omission rather than a provider price change. The Internet Archive CDX request for the June 2025 pricing page returned HTTP 503, and the available Google source does not state exact prices; classification and previous official amounts therefore remain unclear.
